note: Floyd County VA publishes zoning only through its iGIS web viewer (Public Access, floydcova.interactivegis.com), which exposes no ArcGIS REST or downloadable zoning layer that could be found. Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the county and town sites found no queryable zoning district service. The Town of Floyd's Official Zoning Districts Map is kept as a document in the Zoning Administrator's office; the town code links only the ordinance PDF and a future land use JPG.
